message:
## Vulnerability Digest

**Scan window:** 2026-11-06 13:10 IST to 2026-11-07 13:10 IST  
**Scope:** DLL components from `DLL_software_component.txt` only

No new, credible security vulnerabilities reported in the last 24 hours were verified as affecting the monitored DLL components.

### Findings

None.

### MongoDB ecosystem sweep

The dedicated sweep covered MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, mongod, mongos, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, mongosh, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, official drivers and libraries, connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, and official integrations.

No new MongoDB security vulnerability was verified inside the scan window. The [official MongoDB alerts page](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts) contains a November 6 SQL Interface correctness alert, but it is an operational data-accuracy issue rather than a security vulnerability or CVE, so it was excluded.

### Assessment notes

Fresh reports involving Progress Kendo UI for Vue and Chartbrew were reviewed but excluded because those are separate products and do not match Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX or an official MongoDB component in this scan's scope. Older relevant advisories and newly republished records for historical CVEs were also excluded as stale.

**Closing:** No immediate vulnerability review is recommended from this DLL-only scan. Continue routine monitoring.
